solutions.latex:
$V = \pi r^2 h + \dfrac{4}{3}\pi r^3$

$= \pi \times 3^2 \times 12 + \dfrac{4}{3} \times \pi \times 3^3$

$= 108\pi + 36\pi$

$= 144\pi$

But capsule is only third full $\therefore$ Volume $= 48\pi$ cm$^3$
solutions.marks_breakdown: 1: volume of cylinder; 1: volume of ends; 1: answer and $\frac{1}{3}$ full

solutions.latex:
Volume of water $= \dfrac{2}{3}\pi r^3 + \pi \times 3^2 \times (h - 3)$

$48\pi = \dfrac{2}{3}\pi r^3 + \pi \times 9 \times (h - 3)$

$48 = \dfrac{2}{3} \times 3^3 + 9h - 27$

$48 = 18 + 9h - 27$

$9h = 57$

$h = 6\dfrac{1}{3}$ (cm) (accept $6.\dot{3}$ or 6.3)
solutions.marks_breakdown: 1: correct volume; 1: correct substitution in formula; 1: correct answer
